name: maxdrawdown
title: The deepest drop from a running peak, and the 1-based peak and trough.

origin.description: The deepest drop from a running peak, and the 1-based peak and trough.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: The deepest drop from a running peak, and the 1-based peak and trough.
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
md <- maxdrawdown(c(1, 3, 2, 5, 1, 4))
paste(cell(md$maxdrawdown), paste(md$from, collapse = ","), paste(md$to, collapse = ","), sep = "|")

translation.description: The deepest drop from a running peak, and the 1-based peak and trough.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

translation.details: The deepest drop from a running peak, and the 1-based peak and trough.
translation.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
translation.example:
md = maxdrawdown([1, 3, 2, 5, 1, 4])
return cell(md["maxdrawdown"]) + "|" + ",".join(str(v) for v in md["from"]) + "|" + ",".join(str(v) for v in md["to"])
